output.text: This hollow crown is designed for a dramatic reveal in a royal tragedy. Constructed from lightweight aluminum with a polished finish, it appears solid at a glance. The magnetic seam runs vertically down the front, allowing a single-handed, smooth opening during the performance. Inside, three cloth feathers—dyed deep crimson with gold trim—unfold silently when the crown opens, catching the spotlight. The mechanism is tested for 500+ cycles and includes a fail-safe latch. Ensure the magnetic seam aligns precisely during assembly; misalignment causes resistance. The feathers must be hand-stitched and secured to a central pivot. Final inspection: crown must close flush, with no visible gap. This prop delivers a striking visual without compromising actor mobility. Use only approved adhesives and magnetic strips. The hollow crown, magnetic seam, and three cloth feathers are critical to the effect.
